opportunities.title: Public Notice: Surplus Brick Dust Available for Sale
opportunities.desc: The Town of Christiansburg will make surplus brick dust available for sale to the general public at $50.00 for a 2-yard bucket (approximately 2 tons) at the Town Public Works complex at 300 Scattergood Drive, N.W., Christiansburg, VA 24073. The Town will load the surplus in 2-yard increments Monday through Friday, excluding Town holidays 8:30 a.m. until 4 p.m. with 48-hour notice.
